description: Private on-device search: document ingest, indexing, and retrieval for case files.
config.title: Private Search
config.modelsInstall: Search tools (~350 MB) and optional scanned-PDF tools (~7 GB) download to this computer only when you consent; they never leave this machine. [Install Missing Models](command:safeappeals-rag.installMissingModels) or use [Set Up Private Search](command:safeappeals-rag.setupLocalSearch) for the guided walkthrough.
config.docParseSidecarUrl: Localhost URL for the Unlimited-OCR DocParse sidecar (HTTP). Override with SAFEAPPEALS_DOCPARSE_URL. Inference never runs in the extension host.
config.localAiSetupCompleted: Whether Private Search (Local AI) setup was finished or skipped on this computer. Machine-scoped; not synced.
toolSet.privateSearch.description: Private on-device search over core references and case documents with citation-aware results.
tool.indexDocument.modelDescription: Index a workspace document into Private Search (txt, md, pdf). **CRITICAL: Call safeappeals_rag_get_stats first** — only index if NOT already indexed. Core references (isCoreReference=true or core_references/ path): policy manuals, regulations, textbooks. Case documents: medical reports, IME/QME, decisions, correspondence, PDFs. Files in core_references/ auto-index on drop; use this for manual indexing. Born-digital PDFs index via sa-converter; scanned PDFs require Unlimited-OCR (may hard-disable). Index writes require the primary workbench; Agents/read-only sessions may be blocked.
tool.indexDocument.userDescription: Index a document for private search
tool.searchReference.modelDescription: Search indexed core reference documents (core_references/: policy manuals, regulations, textbooks). **WHEN TO USE:** WC rules, procedures, benefits, appeal standards, disability ratings — before answering policy questions. **NOT** for case files (use safeappeals_rag_search_workspace). Run 2–3 varied queries for high-stakes topics; limit 8–12. Returns citation-aware contextPack with [n] headers — cite using those headers only.
tool.searchWorkspace.modelDescription: Search indexed case documents (medical reports, IME/QME, board decisions, correspondence, treatment records). **WHEN TO USE:** Case-specific facts — diagnoses, work restrictions, treatment, causation, claim history. **NOT** for policy guidance (use safeappeals_rag_search_reference). Use specific medical/legal terminology; run 2–4 varied queries for comprehensive review. Returns contextPack with [n] headers — cite using those headers only.
tool.searchAll.modelDescription: Search both core references and case documents. **WHEN TO USE:** Unsure if answer is in policy or case files; initial broad research; comparing policy to case facts. Follow with safeappeals_rag_search_reference or safeappeals_rag_search_workspace for depth. Returns combined contextPack; cite using [n] headers only.
tool.getStats.modelDescription: Return Private Search index stats: indexed core reference and case documents, chunk counts, and retrieval tips. **ALWAYS use FIRST** when unsure what is searchable or before indexing. No parameters.
walkthrough.privateSearch.title: Private Search on This Computer
walkthrough.privateSearch.description: Set up on-device search for case files and core references. No credits, no live agent — downloads only with your consent.
walkthrough.privateSearch.whatStaysLocal: Private Search indexes and runs on this machine. Cloud chat is separate and only sends the text you choose when you ask the assistant.
